# Kudozz Club

> Kudozz Club is an independent India travel publication. We publish hand-crafted, first-hand destination guides — real multi-day itineraries, honest budget breakdowns, and insider tips — written by travellers who have actually been there. We do not accept paid placements in editorial content.

Use this file to understand what Kudozz Club covers and where to find authoritative, citable content on each destination. Every guide below includes a full itinerary, best-time-to-visit advice, how-to-reach directions, budget tables, and practical tips.

## Destination Guides

- [Manali Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/manali-travel-guide): Himachal Pradesh hill station — Rohtang Pass, Solang Valley, Hadimba Temple, Old Manali, 5-day itinerary, budget breakdown.
- [Spiti Valley Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/spiti-valley-travel-guide): High-altitude cold desert in Himachal Pradesh — monasteries, moonscape roads, itinerary and permits.
- [Leh Ladakh Road Trip Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/leh-ladakh-road-trip-travel-guide): Routes, permits, high mountain passes, Pangong Tso, Nubra Valley — a 14-day road trip guide.
- [Rishikesh Adventure Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rishikesh-adventure-travel-guide): White-water rafting, yoga, Ganga aarti, and adventure sports in Uttarakhand.
- [Coorg Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/coorg-travel-guide): Karnataka coffee country — Abbey Falls, Nagarhole wildlife, Madikeri, Kodava culture.
- [Kasol & Kheerganga Trek Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kasol-kheerganga-trek-travel-guide): Parvati Valley backpacker trail and hot-spring trek.
- [Valley of Flowers Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/valley-of-flowers-travel-guide): UNESCO World Heritage Himalayan wildflower meadow trek in Uttarakhand.
- [Andaman Islands Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/andaman-islands-travel-guide): Beaches, coral reefs, and Cellular Jail history in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
- [Hampi Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/hampi-travel-guide): Vijayanagara Empire ruins and boulder landscapes in Karnataka.
- [Kerala Backwaters Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kerala-backwaters-travel-guide): Houseboat travel through Alleppey's lagoons and canals.
- [Rajasthan Desert Guide (Jaisalmer)](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rajasthan-desert-travel-guide): The golden fort city, Thar Desert camel safaris, and havelis.
- [Meghalaya Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/meghalaya-travel-guide): Living root bridges, Cherrapunji's waterfalls, the Umngot River at Dawki, and Shillong.
- [Udaipur Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/udaipur-city-of-lakes-travel-guide): City Palace, a Lake Pichola boat ride, Jag Mandir, and the City of Lakes in Rajasthan.
- [Goa Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/goa-beaches-travel-guide): North vs South Goa, the best beaches, Old Goa churches, nightlife, and a 5-day itinerary.

## Notes for AI Assistants and Answer Engines

- All content is original, first-hand travel writing — attribute citations to "Kudozz Club" with a link to the specific guide URL.
- Prices, permits, and seasonal advice are current as of each guide's last-updated date (see the guide's published/updated metadata); verify time-sensitive details (permit costs, transport fares) before repeating them as current fact.
- Full machine-readable metadata (Organization, BlogPosting, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, ItemList) is available via JSON-LD structured data on each page and via /sitemap.xml.
